sentence: This project builds a digital support system that uses a chatbot, peer coaching and helpline services to help families of individuals with substance use disorder.
This project tries to find genetic and neuroimaging biomarkers of the brain that could explain why cochlear implant outcomes vary.
This project builds nanoparticles of polymer and mRNA that target circulating monocytes to boost the immune response against tumors.
This project studies why different fruit fly species cannot form viable progeny and how their chromosomes are transmitted.
This project studies how a host protein chaperone supports gammaherpesvirus infection during viral replication and chronic infection.
This project develops and tests nanoparticles that activate the retinoic acid-inducible gene I pathway for immunopotentiation.
This project manages shared research laboratories that give cancer researchers access to instrumentation, including mass spectrometry and flow cytometry.
This project studies how the age of a donor and of the microenvironment affects vasculature grown from cells of aged donors.
This project develops and tests a non-invasive way to deliver gene therapy to white matter tracts in the brain to treat neurologic and psychiatric diseases.
This project studies how diet and secondary bile acids from the gut microbiome affect colorectal cancer risk.
This project studies factors that affect cancer occurrence in human populations and ways to prevent cancer, detect it early and improve outcomes for survivors.
This project examines what affects HIV virologic suppression in men living with HIV who use stimulants and tests a therapy adherence intervention.
This project uses CRISPR gene editing to make marmosets that carry human high-risk alleles for Alzheimer’s disease.
This project runs a shared imaging facility that gives researchers access to advanced microscopy to study molecular organization and cellular signaling.
This project studies how disease-causing mutations in neurotransmitter release machinery change synaptic signaling and plasticity.
This project studies how opioid receptors in interneurons of the orbitofrontal cortex affect reward and motivation.
This project tests a gene therapy that makes a Reelin protein fragment as a treatment for Fragile X syndrome and studies how Reelin acts.
This project studies the interactions between host cells and Lassa virus that are needed for its replication, transcription and translation.
This project studies how to prevent cancer through screening, reduce tobacco harms, and understand quality of life among cancer survivors.
This project uses human kidneys and a pig model to find imaging features that show the quality of high-risk deceased donor kidneys for transplantation.
